method: Whole-source/whole-figure visual inspection. Tire-plane center for mounted figures; standing boot support for slam. Single anatomical scale from visible standing rider, overhead motorcycle and raised arms excluded. Hair-to-sole body measurement is approximate because machine overlaps the crown.
hairRevision: Broad violet streaks through fringe, temples, side/rear locks and nape in all twelve full figures per human request on 25 October; skin and dark-red eyes preserved.
